harnessEngineering.systemOfRecord: All decisions in docs/. Repository is the only shared memory.

priceSource.primary: SerpAPI Google Flights (SERPAPI_API_KEY) -- manual use only, never called in CI or ralph
priceSource.legacy: Kiwi.com Tequila (TEQUILA_API_KEY) -- fallback if SerpAPI key absent, sign-up broken as of 2026
priceSource.phase2secondary: Amadeus Flight Price Analysis (AMADEUS_CLIENT_ID/SECRET) -- optional price level signal enrichment
priceSource.phase3international: SerpAPI with per-country gl routing -- BNE->SIN uses gl=sg, BNE->LHR uses gl=gb

layers.2: fees, calendar, currency, airports -- static data loaders and converters
layers.3: recommender, true_cost -- pure logic, no I/O
layers.5: tracker, scout, analytics, insights, notifier, planner -- orchestration

testingPolicy.noRealAPICalls: CI always sets SERPAPI_API_KEY='', TEQUILA_API_KEY='', ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=''
testingPolicy.httpMocking: pytest-httpx mocks all httpx calls at the transport boundary
testingPolicy.stubPriceSource: _StubTequilaSource in conftest.py is the canonical deterministic Pluggy plugin for all integration tests -- all adapters (SerpAPI, Tequila, Amadeus) share the same hookspec
testingPolicy.noInternalPatching: Never patch fly_o_myte.* internals. Only mock at process boundaries.

stories.title: fom plan -- natural language trip planner
stories.description: New command for planning a trip from a loose natural language idea ('Sri Lanka in December') or from structured prompts (fallback). Uses Pydantic AI to extract a typed TripIntent. Runs scout_month internally, shows results with school holiday flags, and ends with a watch prompt. ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is optional -- without it, the same flow runs as numbered Rich prompts with a printed note explaining the capability loss.
acceptanceCriteria: fly_o_myte/planner.py created at layer 5 (same layer as tracker.py, insights.py)

TripIntent dataclass: destination_iata: str, destination_display: str, month: int, year: int, nights: int, flex_days: int, origin_override: str | None. All fields validated. No raw dicts across boundaries.
extract_trip_intent(text: str, api_key: str | None) -> TripIntent: Pydantic AI agent call when api_key present; structured Rich prompt wizard when absent

Fallback wizard prints: 'Note: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY not set. Using structured prompts. (Set this key to enable natural language input like "Sri Lanka in December".)' -- then asks destination, month, year, nights, flex one at a time

Destination resolution: calls airports.resolve_destination(). If 1 match: confirm with user ('Destination: CMB Colombo -- is this right? [y/n]'). If >1 match: show numbered list, ask to pick. If 0 matches: print known destinations hint and ask again.

Origin override: if NL text contains 'from <city>' pattern, extract and resolve via airports.py or _AU_AIRPORTS. Ask to confirm: 'Origin: SYD (from your input) instead of BNE (profile). Use SYD for this search? [y/n]'
After resolving intent: runs scout_month() for the destination, origin, month/year, using profile family params
Results display: print_flex_results table reused (delta column blank -- no tracked price yet). School holiday windows marked. Budget filtered if --budget flag set.
School holiday warning: if top results fall in holiday window, print '[yellow]Note: top {N} windows overlap {label} -- prices are typically 15-30% higher. Cheaper windows shown below.[/yellow]'

--budget <AUD> flag: filters scout_month results to windows with true_family_cost <= budget before display. If all exceed budget: 'No windows found under ${budget:,.0f}. Showing cheapest 3 for reference.'

Watch prompt: 'Start tracking one of these? [1-N/n]' -- on selection: creates trip via poll_trip equivalent, prints 'Tracking trip #{id}: {label}  Initial price: ${cost:,.0f} AUD  QF . 1 stop . departs HH:MM'
